boundary_scope: 32 client attempts do not imply 32 native pool identities; validation may queue requests.
No refusal count is required; all 32 may succeed. This cannot establish the exact admission peak.
Only success contributes to successful_rps. Rejection and other-error rates/latencies are separate.
Post-drain probes are new planned read requests, not automatic retries.
CPU is synchronous controller CPU per attempt; no per-class or whole-cluster CPU attribution.
100 ms descendant samples remain incomplete and can double-count shared memory.
interpretation: One finite ABBA with two samples per arm. Original aggregate gates rejected R21; this does not establish a necessary causal regression from the code, a noise explanation, or global optimality. No samples were removed.
io_scope: No per-call disk I/O improvement is quantified. Archive/log/response byte counts are evidence sizes; /proc/stat snapshots are machine counters, not per-operation disk-byte measurements.

lifecycle_scope.controller_cpu: same PID/start-ticks raw /proc utime+stime; excludes SSH/remote processes
lifecycle_scope.cpu_window: before counter read ends before phase; after read starts after phase
lifecycle_scope.performance_adoption: descriptive only; two samples per arm, no significance or maximum-concurrency claim
lifecycle_scope.phase_wall: whole six-host phase including confirmations, polling and independent SSH inspections
lifecycle_scope.rss: original controller/descendant sample traces retained; no new RSS peak estimator

measurement_scope.inference: One finite shared-host ABBA; two samples per arm; no significance, global optimality or maximum sustainable launch-rate claim.
measurement_scope.lifecycle_cpu: Existing same PID/start-ticks phase counters; excludes SSH and remote CPU; prepare has no active controller.
measurement_scope.lifecycle_wall: Whole C6 phase including confirmations, original bounded polling and independent SSH inspections.
measurement_scope.native_cpu: Synchronous same-controller /proc counters per completed measured observation call; excludes SSH and remote CPU.
measurement_scope.native_rate_p95: Original pooled raw-call nearest-rank p95 and total calls divided by sum of same-arm cell windows; no mean of round rates.
measurement_scope.rss_io: Original sampled controller/process-tree/resource traces and their recorded errors; no new peak, per-call RSS reduction or synchronized cluster-total estimator.

restart_shutdown.scope: Two process-lifetime sampled VmHWM maxima per arm; descriptive only, not per-call allocation or cluster RSS.

shutdown.scope: Two process-lifetime sampled VmHWM maxima per arm; descriptive only, not per-call allocation or cluster RSS.

native_counts.scope: Warmup and all 72 preflight/restart calls are excluded from the performance denominator; a deviation is retained and fails, not normalized away.

native_metrics.scope: one finite shared-host campaign; paired signs and pooled changes are not interchangeable

native_regression_screen.scope: preregistered finite-run aggregate regression screen; not a confidence interval
